pages.text: Craft the $(bold)Salt Pan$() with a $(bold)string$() in each of the four corners and $(bold)cobblestone$() in the other five slots - four pans per craft. It starts out dry; let water touch its top face (water directly above it) and the texture turns into the wet $(bold)Salt Pan II$() state.

About ten seconds later it drinks the water above and forms a separate $(bold)Salt Pile$() on top of itself - an independent block that then grows on its own from stage 1 up to stage 3, each pile taller than the last.

The pile is very soft and breaks by hand: at stages 1, 2 and 3 it drops $(bold)1, 2 and 3$() salt, with a $(bold)Fortune$() bonus. Mining the pile never damages the pan - it returns to its dry state and can be reused.
